reasoning: 驗證目標：選取某 genre 時，列出該 genre 內全部可用頻道並可調諧至其中任一。為什麼這樣切：條款有兩個並列產出——清單成員資格與可調諧性。成員資格以雙向斷言表述（該 genre 的在內、他 genre 的不在內），可調諧性則以調諧結果表述，且對非清單首列的頻道測一次以排除「只能選第一個」的實作。

tcs.tc_title: Selecting a genre lists its channels and tunes to one
tcs.test_item: When a Genre is selected, the HU shall list all available channels within that genre and allow the user to tune to any of those channels listed
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. One genre holds at least two receivable Satellite Audio channels
5. At least one receivable channel belongs to a different genre
6. None of the channels of that genre is the currently tuned channel
7. The list of genres is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Select the genre that holds at least two channels
2. Read the displayed list
3. Select the second channel in the list and read the tuned channel
tcs.expected_result:
1. The genre is accepted as a selection
2. The list holds the channels of that genre and does not hold the channel belonging to the other genre
3. The tuned channel is the second channel of the list
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
